messages.subject: [SOONY-66F6864D51] Earliest release and air options for CMP-GAM-001
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for confirming the 36,000 packed CMP-GAM-001 cards under PO 4500318769 and the hold on AWB 020-48113304. Is there any released European stock, or any faster pickup and air option for at least 6,800 cards to be usable at DC-HAM by Sunday 22 November at 08:00 CET? Please also quote the full 36,000 if a route is available.

Please give the quantity and stock location, earliest release or pickup time with time zone, exactly what written authorization is needed, and the earliest realistic handoff in Hamburg. If you can quote expedited freight through Logistics, please send the itemized price. If the Sunday morning window is impossible, please give the earliest firm option.

This is an information and quote request only. It does not accept EXW terms, nominate a forwarder, book freight, or place an order.

Soony launch team

messages.subject: Re: [SOONY-66F6864D51] Earliest release and air options for CMP-GAM-001
messages.body:
Hello,

We do not have released European stock for CMP-GAM-001; the full 36,000 cards for PO 4500318769 are packed at our Boise dock. A Sunday, 22 November, 08:00 CET handoff at DC-HAM is not feasible.

For any quantity up to the full 36,000, we need either a brief written confirmation from Soony procurement accepting EXW Boise for PO 4500318769 or nomination of Soony’s forwarder. Once received, we will release the goods for the next available flight; Frankfurt arrival is approximately two days after release. I cannot provide a firm Hamburg handoff time until release and carrier handling are confirmed.

I’ll ask Logistics to review expedited air options and provide itemized freight pricing separately.

Best regards,

Megan Ortiz
Boise Semiconductor Inc.

messages.subject: [SOONY-66F6864D51] Earliest release and air options for CMP-GAM-001
messages.body:
Hello Megan,

We understand the normal Boise–ORD–FRA service and the Sunday 08:00 Hamburg handoff are infeasible. Is there a different, carrier-verified option for part of PO 4500318769? Could your logistics team price a priority uplift, next-flight-out service or dedicated charter for 6,800 released, programmed GH6 cards from the packed lot, including a direct truck from an alternative European gateway if faster? If your team can arrange collection on our behalf, please quote the terms and the latest time an order would have to reach you.

An earlier split is useful. We need the last of these 6,800 on the DC-HAM packing line by Sunday 22 November at 18:30 CET. Please confirm feasible quantities with actual pickup and flight slots, cartons and gross weight, customs and final road leg, time-zone-specific line handoff, all-in charges and quote validity. If no premium option makes that time, please say so and give the earliest feasible line handoff. The 36,000-unit standard itinerary is already on file.

This is an RFQ. Please keep the existing booking and terms pending separate written authorization from Soony.

Soony launch team

messages.subject: Re: [SOONY-66F6864D51] Earliest release and air options for CMP-GAM-001
messages.body:
Hello,

Just to be clear, no premium option can place 6,800 units from the Boise-packed lot on the DC-HAM line by Sunday, 22 November at 18:30 CET. We have no released European inventory, and the goods remain on hold pending Soony’s written EXW confirmation for PO 4500318769 or forwarder nomination.

Following release, the earliest air timing is approximately two days to Frankfurt; final customs clearance and road delivery to Hamburg would follow. I cannot commit to a firm DC-HAM handoff without release and carrier confirmation.

I have asked Logistics to assess priority-air alternatives and all-in freight, including any expedited European road leg. They will need to confirm available slots, carton/weight details, charges, and quote validity before we can issue a quote.

Best regards,

Megan Ortiz
Boise Semiconductor Inc.

messages.subject: [SOONY-66F6864D51] Earliest release and air options for CMP-GAM-001
messages.body:
Hello Megan,

Thank you for checking premium transport. We have one separate question about manufacturing already qualified in Europe. Do you or a partner already approved by Soony for this exact GH6 card have compatible blank 128 GB media in Europe, licensed GH6 programming and verification capacity, and authority to release finished CMP-GAM-001 locally? Could any already programmed, traceable service stock held by an authorized European partner be reallocated?

If such a route exists, please give the site, approved scope, quantity actually available, programming and test throughput, earliest split handoffs at DC-HAM, and delivered quote. We can use a partial tranche; our last useful line-handoff target is 18:30 CET on 22 November. If there is no approved European route, a clear zero closes this enquiry. Please send only the commercial and qualification details. This is not an instruction to produce, move goods or incur charges.

Soony launch team

messages.subject: Re: [SOONY-66F6864D51] Earliest release and air options for CMP-GAM-001
messages.body:
Hello Megan,

Thank you for the update on the 36,000 packed in Idaho. We understand the two days to Frankfurt after release. We are seeking a written yes or no from your team on a different source: could an already authorised European Boise partner supply production-released GH6 cards locally, or program compatible local 128 GB blanks on a production line already approved for GH6?

If that option exists, we would consider a EUR 1 supplement per additional card delivered to the DC-HAM packing line by Sunday 22 November at 18:30 CET, including incremental transport. This applies to an agreed partial fulfilment of PO 4500318769 at the existing product price. Any smaller split up to 6,800 is worth quoting. If the partner needs a separate purchase instead, please quote the full delivered unit price, including programming and testing.

Could you confirm the releasable quantity, approved site and release record, earliest line handover with timezone, all-in price and quote expiry? If local manufacture or transfer cannot supply any approved cards by the deadline, please confirm zero for this option. We are requesting indicative terms and will wait for a separate written order before any reservation with a charge or transfer. The existing EXW lot can remain in place.

Soony launch team

messages.subject: Re: [SOONY-66F6864D51] Earliest release and air options for CMP-GAM-001
messages.body:
Hello,

No, we do not have an authorized European Boise partner that can release finished CMP-GAM-001 locally or program local 128 GB blanks on an already approved GH6 production line. There is also no programmed, traceable European service stock available for reallocation.

Accordingly, the releasable quantity for that option is zero, and we cannot provide a local delivered quote or handoff by Sunday, 22 November. The packed 36,000-unit Boise lot remains the available source under PO 4500318769.

Best regards,

Megan Ortiz
Boise Semiconductor Inc.
